name: The rules that stop a vat

pages.text: If $(item)any$() attached machine is not working, $(item)no recipe runs at all$(), even one that does not need that machine. A mixer below 30 RPM, a compressor below 120 RPM, an unpowered freezer or an electrode holder with too little current all freeze the whole vat. Remove the machine or get it running.
Extra working machines are fine: a recipe needs $(item)at least$() the machines it lists.

$(l)Pipes and funnels$()$(br)Pipes, funnels and hoppers can only $(item)fill the inputs$() and $(item)drain the outputs$(). You cannot pull an ingredient back out, and nothing can be pushed into an output. Ingredients are only read from the input side.

$(l)Full outputs$()$(br)A recipe only starts when $(item)all$() its products fit. A by-product left in the output (carbon dioxide, slag) will stall the vat sooner or later, so drain it.$(br2)$(l)Breaking a vat$()$(br)Breaking a vat $(item)drops the items$() it held. Its fluids move to the blocks that remain in the multiblock.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
